# FreeResourceAtlas

> A directory of software, apps, games, public projects and learning resources with source links and explicit access/review labels.

English is the default. Interface language suggestions are optional; untranslated resource content remains visibly English.

A discovered listing is not automatically reviewed, free, secure, tested or indexed. Follow the original provider for current terms and availability. Paid games and limited free plans are labeled.

- [Templates and previews](https://freeresourceatlas.com/templates)
- [Owner-published download links](https://freeresourceatlas.com/downloads)

The original template collection has 100 published templates with 240 licensed native files. Use the live template pages for available formats and download links. No ranking, security, income or compatibility guarantee is made. This document describes the website; it is not an indexing or AI-citation mechanism.
